headline: Nasdaq sell-off batters Asian chip stocks
detail: This headline directly impacts your concentrated tech and chip holdings. The weakness seen in Asia suggests continued pressure on names like SMH, SOXL, and others in your portfolio.
rec: Consider trimming positions like SMH or SOXL if they show further downside, given the negative sentiment in the sector.

headline: AI debt concerns grow as ING reportedly seeks buyers for data center loans
detail: This points to potential headwinds for companies involved in data centers and AI infrastructure. While not directly naming your holdings, it adds to the broader concerns around tech valuations and debt.

headline: Democrat sweep gives markets a reason to rethink path of interest rates

rec: Monitor how this potential shift in interest rate expectations impacts your tech holdings.
